scope: Review of the next 15 alphabetically pending active catalog entries, eesel AI through Flair AI. All 15 accepted after first-party checks; no removals, supersessions or status-watch changes.

accepted.name: eesel AI
accepted.description: AI customer-support workspace with autonomous helpdesk agents, human-review copilot, ticket triage, website chatbot and internal knowledge agent, grounded in connected helpdesks, Slack and company knowledge.
accepted.userValue: For support teams that want to automate routine tickets and assist human agents using existing helpdesk content and workflows, with review and escalation controls.

accepted.name: Eightfold AI
accepted.description: Agentic talent-intelligence platform that models skills, experience, aspirations and work context to support talent acquisition, internal mobility, workforce planning, talent management and AI-powered recruiting agents.
accepted.userValue: For enterprise HR and talent teams that need skills-based hiring and workforce decisions across recruiting, development and planning rather than résumé keyword matching alone.

accepted.name: Elai.io
accepted.description: AI text-to-video platform for creating presenter-led training and explainer videos from scripts, documents and presentations, with customizable avatars, voice cloning, multilingual narration and interactive learning elements.
accepted.userValue: For organizations that need to produce and localize training or instructional videos without filming every presenter-led lesson.

accepted.name: Elephas
accepted.description: Private AI knowledge workspace for Mac with local document indexing, chat over PDFs and notes, cited answers, web search and agents; supports offline/on-device operation, optional cloud models and iPhone/iPad access.
accepted.userValue: For Mac users who want an assistant grounded in personal files and notes while keeping indexing local and choosing where AI processing happens.

accepted.name: EvenUp
accepted.description: AI platform for plaintiff personal-injury law firms that organizes medical records, builds treatment timelines and damages summaries, and drafts evidence-grounded settlement demand packages with legal and medical review workflows.
accepted.userValue: For personal-injury firms handling high volumes of medical records and demand preparation; attorneys remain responsible for verifying evidence and legal conclusions.

accepted.name: Exa
accepted.description: Neural web-search and retrieval API for AI applications, with semantic and keyword search, page contents, structured results, crawling and research workflows designed for agents and RAG systems.
accepted.userValue: For developers building research agents and AI applications that need relevant web sources and clean page content rather than relying only on conventional keyword search.

accepted.name: Explainpaper
accepted.description: AI research-paper reader that explains highlighted passages in context, answers follow-up questions grounded in the uploaded paper, cites relevant sections and generates outlines, key findings and summaries.
accepted.userValue: For students and researchers who need help understanding dense papers while keeping explanations tied to the source document and its exact sections.

accepted.name: fal
accepted.description: Inference platform for generative media and world models, providing hosted APIs for image, video, audio and 3D models plus autoscaling serverless GPUs for deploying custom models and pipelines.
accepted.userValue: For developers and creative platforms that need production inference for generative-media models without provisioning and operating GPU infrastructure themselves.

accepted.name: FeedHive
accepted.description: AI social-media workspace for generating on-brand captions and visuals, planning and scheduling posts, automating publishing conditions, collaborating with teams and connecting external AI agents through API and MCP.
accepted.userValue: For creators, brands and agencies that want AI-assisted content creation and controlled cross-channel publishing in one workflow.

accepted.name: Felo
accepted.description: Multilingual AI search and creation platform that combines cited web research with deep-research agents, AI slides and PowerPoint, mind maps, document and webpage creation, and image/video tools.
accepted.userValue: For users who want to move from multilingual research and source discovery to structured reports, presentations and other deliverables in one workspace.

accepted.name: Filmora AI
accepted.description: AI feature suite inside Wondershare Filmora, including text-to-video and image-to-video, AI portrait and cutout, smart scene and audio tools, speech-to-text, text-based editing and generative editing workflows.
accepted.userValue: For video editors who want AI-assisted generation, cleanup and editing inside a familiar timeline editor rather than a separate generation-only app. This is a Filmora capability suite.

accepted.name: Findem
accepted.description: AI people-intelligence platform that builds a contextual graph of skills, career signals and relationships to power talent sourcing, executive search, candidate engagement, workforce planning and agentic people workflows.
accepted.userValue: For recruiting and HR teams that need evidence-rich talent discovery and workforce insight beyond static résumés and keyword filters.

accepted.name: Firecrawl
accepted.description: Web data API and open-source toolkit for crawling, scraping, mapping and searching websites into clean Markdown or structured data for LLMs and agents, with extraction schemas, browser rendering and MCP integration.
accepted.userValue: For developers building RAG, research agents and data pipelines that need reliable, structured web content from live sites.

accepted.name: Fireworks AI
accepted.description: Inference and model-training platform for open and custom AI models, with serverless APIs, dedicated autoscaling GPU deployments, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement fine-tuning for production workloads.
accepted.userValue: For teams that need low-latency production serving and customization of open models without building their own inference and GPU-training stack.

accepted.name: Flair AI
accepted.description: AI visual-production platform for branded product and marketing imagery, with drag-and-drop scene staging, custom product or human models, image editing, variations, upscaling and short video generation.
accepted.userValue: For ecommerce and marketing teams that need consistent branded product visuals and campaign assets without arranging a new photoshoot for each variation.

notes: Elai.io was acquired by Panopto in October 2024, but its own official pricing page remains active and lists current standalone subscriptions and a 2026 copyright notice; it is retained as an active product under its acquired ownership.
Filmora AI is explicitly represented as an integrated feature suite within Wondershare Filmora, not as a separate standalone product.

Explainpaper is retained as a focused research-paper workflow because it offers in-context explanations, source-section citations, adjustable complexity, paper-aware follow-up Q&A and structured paper insights, not merely generic chat over arbitrary files.
FeedHive's current official site announces v2.0 and documents AI agents, AI content generation, social publishing and automation; older positioning has been refreshed.
Elephas is a Mac-first private knowledge workspace with local indexing and offline/on-device modes; optional cloud AI is separately described and not confused with local inference.
EvenUp is described as assistive legal-work software for plaintiff personal-injury firms; the catalog does not imply autonomous legal advice or replace attorney verification.
